settings.title: Notifications
settings.description: Choose what reaches you when you're not on Zenbree. Everything is always under the bell in the app.
settings.loadError: Could not load your notification settings.

replyUrgent.label: Interested reply or meeting request
replyUrgent.help: At most one email every 30 minutes; the rest go in the digest. Never the reply's text.

reply.label: Other replies
reply.help: Not now, not interested, automatic replies. Digest only.

approvalNeeded.label: Messages to approve
approvalNeeded.help: Digest only, with the number still waiting.

searchDone.label: Search finished
searchDone.help: Only if the search takes more than 5 minutes or Zenbree is closed.

searchFailed.label: Search stopped or your choice needed
searchFailed.help: When a provider stops a search you're not watching. The email counts toward the limit of one urgent email every 30 minutes.

bouncesHigh.label: Too many bounces in a campaign
bouncesHigh.help: More than 5% invalid addresses, with at least 20 people to write to. The campaign does not pause by itself.

lowCredits.label: Credits under 200
lowCredits.help: Once, until you top up. Never with automatic top-up on.

mailboxError.label: Mailbox disconnected or blocked
mailboxError.help: Campaigns that use it don't send until you reconnect it.

locked.label: Receipts, renewals and security
locked.help: Payments, plan renewal, new sign-in, password change

browser.title: Browser notifications
browser.on: Browser notifications are on for this computer.

ask.title: Get replies even when Zenbree is closed.
ask.body: Your browser will ask for permission once.
ask.inPageTitle: Get a browser alert while Zenbree is open.

denied.title: Your browser blocks Zenbree notifications.
denied.body: To turn them on, open the site settings (the icon left of the address) and allow notifications. Then come back to this page. Meanwhile we email you.

unsupported.title: Browser not supported
unsupported.body: This browser doesn't show notifications. The panel and email still work.

browser.enableError: We couldn't turn notifications on. Try again.
browser.testError: The test didn't go out. Turn browser notifications on again and retry.
browser.turnedOff: Browser notifications turned off on this computer.

digest.label: Email digest
digest.help: One email with everything that isn't urgent: replies, messages to approve, finished searches. It only goes out when there's something to say. Times are Italian time.

dnd.label: Do not disturb
dnd.help: No immediate emails or browser notifications: everything stays in the panel and, if on, in the digest. Payments and security still come through.
